Sort first, then backtrack skipping duplicates at each level. O(n*2^n).

For subsets unique basic I will iterate with skip-if-equal.

```python
def subsets_unique(nums):
    nums.sort(); out = []
    def rec(i, cur):
        out.append(cur[:])
        for j in range(i, len(nums)):
            if j > i and nums[j] == nums[j-1]: continue
            cur.append(nums[j])
            rec(j + 1, cur)
            cur.pop()
    rec(0, [])
    return out
```
